package main

// The object-class sweep (TS parity round B7, closing the "trailing field / structural" class mechanically): EVERY OBJECT path class and EVERY SCALAR
// path class of EVERY base document of every suite is given, once per base (the first sweepK documents of each form that hold the class), each of:
//
//	object  - a trailing $epilogue (field numbers 0-8, 31-33, 64 with a value, and the bare bytes 01 03 04 21 ff 80), null, the member deleted, a wrong
//	          JSON type (string, number, array, true), a duplicate key (a wrong value before the member; null and an empty object after it)
//	scalar  - null, the member deleted, a wrong JSON type, a duplicate key (a wrong value before; null and a wrong value after), and for a number
//	          the uint64 edge values (2^53-1, 2^53, 2^63, 2^64-1, 2^64)
//	element - an array element: null, deleted, a wrong JSON type
//
// The validator it is written by is origin/pv2/rb9-f5-certify f16dc64 PLUS the one hunk of pv2/rb9-k-two-voter-vector 8a6790b (RB9-K-F1: pkg/proof/v2/xverify.go
// deriveRoles does not apply the all-authorities-disabled rule to a transaction type that requires authorization): the xpartition6 documents are the RB9-K
// vectors and their verdicts are those of that rule; neither branch contains the other yet (the two merge into main), and without the hunk the oracle judges
// xpartition6/disable-op-voter-outside-the-list-every-authority-disabled.json differently (g1_role_mismatch{BVN3,90}) from the vector's manifest
// (g1_vote_not_reproduced{BVN1,50}). Every other verdict of the 49846 is the same with or without it.
//
// A case is a list of byte edits of the base file, judged as the pathspell corpus is (the validator's json.Unmarshal into Portable and VerifyPortable);
// the file is read by the same consumer (helpers/s3-bytes.ts). The bases are the earlier byte corpora's (xpartition .. xpartition5, both 2.0 fixtures,
// the real document) and the synced suites certify1, xpartition6 and robust1 (named relative to the s3 fixtures directory: ../s3-f5/certify1/...).
//
// Regeneration (12 shards, three Go processes at a time; it writes the pinned files byte for byte, sha256 in test/s3-bytes-objsweep-{1..12}.test.ts):
//
//	git -C <validator> worktree add --detach <judge> f16dc64
//	cd <judge> && git diff 8a6790b^ 8a6790b -- pkg/proof/v2/xverify.go | git apply
//	mkdir cmd/xtsgen && for f in main certify1 x21 intent intent2 facts consensus tables votes bytes fold objsweep judgefile; do cp <certen-sdk>/packages/verify/test/fixtures/s3/gen/xtsgen-$f.go.txt cmd/xtsgen/$f.go; done
//	S3=<certen-sdk>/packages/verify/test/fixtures/s3
//	GOWORK=off go build -trimpath -o xtsgen ./cmd/xtsgen && for g in 0 3 6 9; do for i in $g $((g+1)) $((g+2)); do XTS_SHARD=$i/12 ./xtsgen -fixtures $S3 -out <dir> objsweep & done; wait; done
//
// (each shard is its own file, <dir>/bytes-cases-objsweep-<i>.json.gz for i = 0..11, consumed by test/s3-bytes-objsweep-<i+1>.test.ts)

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"gitlab.com/accumulatenetwork/accumulate/pkg/api/v3"
)

// sweepK is the number of documents of one form that a path class is swept in.
const sweepK = 3

type objNode struct {
	class      string
	key        string
	kind       byte // o object, a array, s string, n number, t true/false, z null
	vs, ve     int  // the value
	closeAt    int  // objects: the position of the closing brace
	nmembers   int  // objects: the member count
	ms         int  // the member (key start), -1 for an array element or the root
	delFrom    int  // the range a delete removes (member or element with its separating comma)
	delTo      int
	inArray    bool
	rootObject bool
}

type objWalker struct {
	b   []byte
	out []objNode
}

func (w *objWalker) ws(i int) int {
	for i < len(w.b) && (w.b[i] == ' ' || w.b[i] == '\n' || w.b[i] == '\t' || w.b[i] == '\r') {
		i++
	}
	return i
}

func (w *objWalker) str(i int) int {
	j := i + 1
	for j < len(w.b) && w.b[j] != '"' {
		if w.b[j] == '\\' {
			j++
		}
		j++
	}
	return j + 1
}

// value walks the value that starts at i (after whitespace) and returns its end. idx is the position in w.out reserved for it.
func (w *objWalker) value(i int, class, key string, ms int, inArray bool) int {
	i = w.ws(i)
	if i >= len(w.b) {
		return i
	}
	n := objNode{class: class, key: key, vs: i, ms: ms, inArray: inArray}
	idx := len(w.out)
	w.out = append(w.out, n)
	var end int
	switch w.b[i] {
	case '"':
		end = w.str(i)
		w.out[idx].kind = 's'
	case '{':
		w.out[idx].kind = 'o'
		type mem struct{ ms, ve int }
		var mems []mem
		j := w.ws(i + 1)
		var kids []int
		for j < len(w.b) && w.b[j] != '}' {
			ke := w.str(j)
			k := string(w.b[j+1 : ke-1])
			name := k
			if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(k), "acc://") {
				name = "{url}"
			}
			c := name
			if class != "" {
				c = class + "." + name
			}
			mstart := j
			j = w.ws(ke)
			j++ // ':'
			kid := len(w.out)
			j = w.value(j, c, name, mstart, false)
			kids = append(kids, kid)
			mems = append(mems, mem{mstart, j})
			j = w.ws(j)
			if j < len(w.b) && w.b[j] == ',' {
				j = w.ws(j + 1)
			}
		}
		w.out[idx].closeAt = j
		w.out[idx].nmembers = len(mems)
		for k, kid := range kids {
			switch {
			case k < len(mems)-1:
				w.out[kid].delFrom, w.out[kid].delTo = mems[k].ms, mems[k+1].ms
			case k > 0:
				w.out[kid].delFrom, w.out[kid].delTo = mems[k-1].ve, mems[k].ve
			default:
				w.out[kid].delFrom, w.out[kid].delTo = mems[k].ms, mems[k].ve
			}
		}
		end = j + 1
	case '[':
		w.out[idx].kind = 'a'
		type el struct{ vs, ve int }
		var els []el
		var kids []int
		j := w.ws(i + 1)
		for j < len(w.b) && w.b[j] != ']' {
			kid := len(w.out)
			s := j
			j = w.value(j, class+"[*]", key, -1, true)
			kids = append(kids, kid)
			els = append(els, el{s, j})
			j = w.ws(j)
			if j < len(w.b) && w.b[j] == ',' {
				j = w.ws(j + 1)
			}
		}
		for k, kid := range kids {
			switch {
			case k < len(els)-1:
				w.out[kid].delFrom, w.out[kid].delTo = els[k].vs, els[k+1].vs
			case k > 0:
				w.out[kid].delFrom, w.out[kid].delTo = els[k-1].ve, els[k].ve
			default:
				w.out[kid].delFrom, w.out[kid].delTo = els[k].vs, els[k].ve
			}
		}
		end = j + 1
	default:
		j := i
		for j < len(w.b) && w.b[j] != ',' && w.b[j] != '}' && w.b[j] != ']' && w.b[j] != ' ' && w.b[j] != '\n' && w.b[j] != '\t' && w.b[j] != '\r' {
			j++
		}
		end = j
		switch w.b[i] {
		case 't', 'f':
			w.out[idx].kind = 't'
		case 'n':
			w.out[idx].kind = 'z'
		default:
			w.out[idx].kind = 'n'
		}
	}
	w.out[idx].ve = end
	return end
}

// objEpilogues are the trailing fields: every field number 0-8, 31-33 and 64 with a value, and the bare bytes that open a field.
var objEpilogues = func() []string {
	var out []string
	for _, n := range []int{0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 31, 32, 33, 64} {
		out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("%02x01aa", n))
	}
	// the epilogues a reader DECODES (RB9-F5-5 V-N): field 1, 2 and 4 of a minor-root record with an empty value, field 3 as one and two empty updates
	// (0300, 03000300), an update with an empty transaction and receipt (030402000200), the same with a root proof of an empty receipt (0302020004020100)
	return append(out, "01", "03", "04", "21", "ff", "80", "0100", "0200", "0400", "04020100", "0300", "03000300", "030402000200", "0302020004020100")
}()

var objU64 = []string{"9007199254740991", "9007199254740992", "9223372036854775808", "18446744073709551615", "18446744073709551616"}

// objWrongs are the JSON values of the other types, by the kind of the value they replace.
func objWrongs(kind byte) []string {
	switch kind {
	case 's':
		return []string{"1", "{}", "[]", "true"}
	case 'n':
		return []string{`"1"`, "{}", "[]", "true"}
	case 'o':
		return []string{`"x"`, "1", "[]", "true"}
	case 'a':
		return []string{`"x"`, "1", "{}", "true"}
	case 't':
		return []string{`"x"`, "1", "{}", "[]"}
	}
	return []string{`"x"`, "1", "{}", "[]"}
}

type objCase struct {
	name  string
	edits []ByteEdit
}

// updateEpilogues are the epilogues made of one complete network update proof of the document itself: field 3 once, field 3 twice, and field 3 once
// after an empty field 2 (the first update of the document's first record that has one, binary-encoded as the validator's reader decodes it).
func updateEpilogues(doc []byte, nodes []objNode) []string {
	for _, n := range nodes {
		if n.kind != 'o' || !strings.HasSuffix(n.class, ".updates[*]") {
			continue
		}
		p := new(api.NetworkUpdateProof)
		if err := json.Unmarshal(doc[n.vs:n.ve], p); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		b, err := p.MarshalBinary()
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		f3 := append([]byte{3}, binary.AppendUvarint(nil, uint64(len(b)))...)
		f3 = append(f3, b...)
		return []string{hex.EncodeToString(f3), hex.EncodeToString(append(append([]byte(nil), f3...), f3...)), hex.EncodeToString(append([]byte{2, 0}, f3...))}
	}
	return nil
}

func objCases(doc []byte, n objNode, upd []string) []objCase {
	var out []objCase
	replace := func(name, v string) {
		out = append(out, objCase{name, []ByteEdit{{n.vs, n.ve - n.vs, ins(v)}}})
	}
	if n.kind == 'o' {
		for _, e := range append(append([]string(nil), objEpilogues...), upd...) {
			text := `"$epilogue":"` + e + `"`
			if n.nmembers > 0 {
				text = "," + text
			}
			out = append(out, objCase{"epilogue-" + e, []ByteEdit{{n.closeAt, 0, ins(text)}}})
		}
	}
	if n.ms < 0 && !n.inArray {
		return out // the root: a trailing field is the only change
	}
	if n.kind != 'z' {
		replace("null", "null")
	}
	for i, w := range objWrongs(n.kind) {
		replace(fmt.Sprintf("wrong-%d", i), w)
	}
	if n.kind == 'n' {
		for _, v := range objU64 {
			replace("u64-"+v, v)
		}
	}
	out = append(out, objCase{"delete", []ByteEdit{{n.delFrom, n.delTo - n.delFrom, ""}}})
	if !n.inArray && n.ms >= 0 {
		key := string(doc[n.ms : n.vs]) // `"key" :` as spelled, with its colon and spacing
		member := key + string(doc[n.vs:n.ve])
		_ = member
		w := objWrongs(n.kind)
		out = append(out, objCase{"dup-wrong-before", []ByteEdit{{n.ms, 0, ins(key + w[0] + ",")}}})
		out = append(out, objCase{"dup-null-after", []ByteEdit{{n.ve, 0, ins("," + key + "null")}}})
		if n.kind == 'o' {
			out = append(out, objCase{"dup-empty-after", []ByteEdit{{n.ve, 0, ins("," + key + "{}")}}})
		} else {
			out = append(out, objCase{"dup-wrong-after", []ByteEdit{{n.ve, 0, ins("," + key + w[1])}}})
		}
	}
	return out
}

var objForm20 = regexp.MustCompile(`"version"\s*:\s*"2\.0"`)

func objBases(fixtures string) ([]string, error) {
	var bases []string
	var m struct {
		Cases []struct {
			File string `json:"file"`
		} `json:"cases"`
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(fixtures, "..", "s3-f5", "certify1", "manifest.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &m); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, c := range m.Cases {
		bases = append(bases, "../s3-f5/certify1/"+c.File)
	}
	for _, d := range []string{"s3-rb9k/xpartition6", "s3-rb9l/robust1"} {
		ents, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(fixtures, "..", d))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		for _, e := range ents {
			if n := e.Name(); !e.IsDir() && strings.HasSuffix(n, ".json") {
				bases = append(bases, "../"+d+"/"+n)
			}
		}
	}
	old, err := bytesBases(fixtures)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return append(bases, old...), nil
}

// judgeSweep judges a document three times: a verdict that differs between runs (Go's map order) has no verdict to match.
func judgeSweep(doc []byte, panics, flaky *int) (Expect, bool) {
	a, ok := judge(doc)
	if !ok {
		*panics++
		return a, false
	}
	for i := 1; i < 3; i++ {
		b, ok := judge(doc)
		if !ok {
			*panics++
			return a, false
		}
		if a.V != b.V || (a.V != "plain" && !reflect.DeepEqual(a, b)) {
			*flaky++
			lastFlaky = brief(a) + " vs " + brief(b)
			return a, false
		}
	}
	return a, true
}

func objSweepCorpus(fixtures, out string) error {
	f := &ByteFile{Format: "certen-sdk/s3-bytes-corpus/v1",
		Description: "Every object path class and every scalar path class of every base document (the first sweepK documents of each form holding the class): a trailing $epilogue (field numbers 0-8, 31-33, 64, bare bytes 01 03 04 21 ff 80), null, the member deleted, a wrong JSON type, a duplicate key, the uint64 edge numbers; array elements nulled, deleted and given a wrong type; judged by VerifyPortable from the text."}
	bases, err := objBases(fixtures)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	f.Bases = bases
	docs := make([][]byte, len(bases))
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		raw, err := baseDoc(fixtures, bpath)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", bpath, err)
		}
		docs[bi] = raw
		be, ok := judgeStableCounting(raw, new(int), new(int))
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: Go is unstable on the base document", bpath)
		}
		f.BaseExpect = append(f.BaseExpect, be)
	}
	shard, shards := 0, 1
	if v := os.Getenv("XTS_SHARD"); v != "" {
		if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(v, "%d/%d", &shard, &shards); err != nil || shards < 1 || shard < 0 || shard >= shards {
			return fmt.Errorf("XTS_SHARD %q: want i/n", v)
		}
	}
	use := map[string]int{}
	classes := map[string]bool{}
	byKind := map[string]int{}
	seq := 0
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		form := "2.1"
		if objForm20.Match(docs[bi]) {
			form = "2.0"
		}
		w := &objWalker{b: docs[bi]}
		w.value(0, "", "", -1, false)
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		upd := updateEpilogues(docs[bi], w.out)
		for _, n := range w.out {
			if n.class == "" {
				n.class = "$root"
			}
			if seen[n.class] {
				continue
			}
			seen[n.class] = true
			k := form + "|" + n.class
			if use[k]++; use[k] > sweepK {
				continue
			}
			classes[form+"|"+n.class] = true
			for _, c := range objCases(docs[bi], n, upd) {
				if seq++; (seq-1)%shards != shard {
					continue
				}
				if os.Getenv("XTS_COUNT") != "" {
					continue
				}
				text := applyEdits(docs[bi], c.edits)
				lastPanic, lastFlaky = "", ""
				ex, ok := judgeSweep(text, &f.Skipped.Panics, &f.Skipped.Flaky)
				if !ok {
					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "PANIC/FLAKY %s %s [%s] %s%s\n", bpath, n.class, c.name, lastPanic, lastFlaky)
					continue
				}
				kind := map[byte]string{'o': "object", 'a': "array", 's': "string", 'n': "number", 't': "bool", 'z': "null"}[n.kind]
				byKind[kind]++
				f.Cases = append(f.Cases, ByteCase{ID: fmt.Sprintf("objsweep:%s:%s:%s", bpath, n.class, c.name), Base: bi, Op: "objsweep " + kind + " " + c.name, Edits: c.edits, Expect: ex})
			}
		}
	}
	var names []string
	for k, v := range byKind {
		names = append(names, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%d", k, v))
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "objsweep shard %d/%d: %d bases, %d path classes (form|class), %d cases in all, %d judged here (%s)\n", shard, shards, len(bases), len(classes), seq, len(f.Cases), strings.Join(names, " "))
	if os.Getenv("XTS_COUNT") != "" {
		return nil
	}
	name := "bytes-cases-objsweep.json.gz"
	if shards > 1 {
		name = fmt.Sprintf("bytes-cases-objsweep-%d.json.gz", shard)
	}
	return writeGz(filepath.Join(out, name), mustJSON(f))
}
